verses: King Wen with earnest purpose toiled, And nothing left undone. 'Tis right his sons should now be styled Lords of the realm he won. Abroad his virtue we will spread; Him in our hearts we'll shrine; Our aim that peace established May last while lasts our line. Through him it was there came to Chou Heaven's favor and decree. Him in our breasts we cherish now; Our pattern shall he be.
